 2026 World Series champion Kalshi trading preview 
 The Brewers swept the back-to-back champion Dodgers in the NLCS to reach the championship, improving to 7-1 this postseason. Milwaukee had the best record in baseball this season at 103-59, led by the No. 2 scoring offense in the sport and the overwhelming favorite to win this year's NL Cy Young in Jacob Misiorowski. The 24-year-old ace will have plenty of rest going into his Game 1 start, last pitching on October 11, and he could go early and often with the Brewers chasing their first title in franchise history.
 Meanwhile, Tampa Bay had the best record in the AL this year at 98-64 and is 7-2 this postseason, knocking off the Yankees and Guardians during the playoffs. The Rays had the seventh-best ERA (3.70) this season, and their offense closed the Cleveland series with 17 runs over the final three games – all victories. The Rays and Brewers played each other in the second series of the 2026 MLB season, with the Brewers winning two of three games.
